full_judgment:
Md. Ruhul Amin J: This petition for leave to appeal has been filed against the judgment dated April 5, 2004 of a Division Bench of the High Court Division in First Appeal No. 167 of 1999 dismissing the same. The appeal was filed against the judgment and decree dated September 30, 1998 of the 1st Court of Sub-ordinate Judge (now Joint District Judge), Kishoreganj in Other Class Suit No. 69 of 1993 decreeing the same. The suit was filed seeking decree for specific performance of contract for sale of land. 

 4. The trial Court on consideration of the materials on record held that the defendant No. 1 agreed to sell the land in question for Taka 2,00,000 and that upon receiving Taka 1,40,000 on August 15, 1991 executed the agreement for sale and that thereafter received Taka 35,000 on January 26, 1992 from the plaintiff and acknowledged the receipt of the said money on the reverse side of the 1st page of the agreement for sale. On the aforesaid finding trial Court decreed the suit. 

 6. The argument was made from the side of the appellant upon referring to the provision of section 22 of the Specific Relief Act but the same was rejected by the High Court Division because of the conduct of the defendant No. 1 since he denied the contract although he entered into agreement for sale of the land. The High Court Division has also observed that no case of hardship was averred in the written statement and that no evidence was also led from the side of the defendant No. 1 in support of the case of hardship in case a decree is passed directing the defendant No. 1 to execute and register the kabala in respect of the land for selling which he executed an agreement for sale on initially receiving Taka 1,40,000 and later on 35,000. 

 8. The High Court Division as well as the trial Court on consideration of the evidence of the parties concurrently held that the plaintiff proved his case and that the defendant executed the agreement for sale on August 15, 1991. The High Court Division as well as the trial Court compared the signature of the defendant No.1 appearing in the agreement for sale with the signatures available in the record and thereupon held that defendant No.1 executed the agreement for sale on August 15, 1991 on the basis whereof the plaintiff has sought for a decree for specific performance of contract for sale of land described in the schedule attached to the plaint.
